text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training with Daiichi Ruby,
I was cleaning up, butâ

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh Gods, Buddhas, and Ruby-sama...!!
Please, by all means, grant me a training run with you~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I apologize.
I have lessons after this, so I must decline.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaa~~h!!
Still, there's no way I can back down either!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It just came up in my training divination! If I don't run alongside an Umamusume whose name starts with "Da", disaster will strike!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I see.
However, taking that on is...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Hello. ...You're feeling unwell, you say?
In that case, let us postpone today's lesson.
Please take good care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Postponed!?!?
Yay! Now you can run alongside me!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...While I agree with additional training
as an effective use of time..."
choice_data_list: Go ahead and pace alongside them.
That'll lead to overwork, so let's not.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...
I believe there is no advantage in tandem training with me, however.
choice_data_list: There are lessons you can only learn running side by side.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Even my training fortune said
'you will definitely reap great results'!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Come, come, right this way!!
The other one is ready for you as well!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey.
Running together with this lineup sounds pretty fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And with that, just as the fortune said! We have Umamusume whose names start with 'Da' and 'Mi'!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Members with varying aptitudes and experience.
There certainly seems to be a lot to learn from this.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I humbly request your participation in a tandem run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, through training together as a trio,
Daiichi Ruby learned a valuable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will return to my room and focus on classroom studies, then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
N-No wayyyy!!
Please, can't you do something?! Anythiiing?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios-san was at the school gate.
An Umamusume whose name starts with 'Da'.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
!? Really?!
Thank you so much for the info!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hurry—!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing left in our way.
...Now, if you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Daiichi Ruby returned to her room and devoted herself to her studies.
